recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a browser-native mobile idle tower game titled `Royal VHS Ghost: Archive Court`. Preserve the mechanics of a vertical idle management tower: start with 300 currency, auto-spawn visitors, assign them to one-at-a-time rooms, complete timed processing for payouts, buy exponentially costed rooms, open a room upgrade modal by tapping rooms, upgrade speed/value with exponential costs, unlock unstable visitors at level 25, unlock special stabilizing rooms at level 28, and drag-scroll the tower.

Theme every safe surface as a Final Fantasy inspired royal VHS ghost court. The central identity is a crowned cassette ghost monarch. Use procedural Canvas art for haunted castle spires, CRT scanlines, royal chambers, Crown Vaults, spectral echoes, cursed echoes, gil particles, and VHS distortion. Use concise mobile HUD language: Royal Gil, Court Lv, Seance Chamber, Crown Vault, Haste Sigil, Tribute Sigil, Cursed Echoes. Keep UI buttons large, readable, and tappable on portrait mobile.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile-first idle/management vertical tower builder rendered with Canvas and DOM HUD controls.
- objective: Spend generated currency to build rooms, process auto-spawned visitors, earn payouts, upgrade rooms, unlock special visitor/room behavior, and grow the tower.
- input model: Tap/click build buttons, tap/click non-base rooms to open an upgrade modal, tap modal buttons to upgrade, and drag the canvas vertically to scroll.
- core loop: Visitors spawn automatically, enter the base, seek an available room, occupy it for a timed process, leave, and award currency. Currency buys more rooms and upgrades, which increases throughput and payout.
- fail/friction state: Insufficient currency blocks purchases/upgrades with feedback; late unstable visitors decay into attack behavior that removes another visitor and themselves.

## Protected mechanics
- Starting currency remains 300.
- Base/reception room exists at start.
- Visitor spawn cadence, cap, movement state machine, room assignment, timed processing, payout, and leaving behavior remain intact.
- Build costs preserve standard and special room exponential formulas.
- Upgrade speed and value formulas remain intact.
- Late unlock thresholds remain level 25 for unstable visitors and level 28 for special rooms.
- Canvas drag scrolling and room tap hit boxes remain mechanic-faithful.

## Remixed target
A Final Fantasy inspired royal VHS ghost court where the player expands the Crowned VHS Ghost Archive. Visitors are spectral echoes, rooms are Seance Chambers, special rooms are Crown Vaults, currency is Royal Gil, and unstable late-game patients become cursed echoes. The loop stays an idle tower economy while the scene, HUD, entities, feedback, fonts, and procedural art become a regal haunted CRT fantasy.
